claim_boundary: direct exhaustive decision for the declared positive rational twelve-atom root-facing rank-three packet cell restricted to functional transfer graphs. UNSAT is a bounded-atom theorem, not a cap-free theorem. SAT is a bounded four-edge no-go profile, but is not a full recurrence countermodel because signed-record reachability and all Hall resets remain unencoded.
edge_definition: number of distinct directed selected-provenance-supplier to final-owner pairs carrying at least one good; retained goods create no edge
empty_owner_omission_justification: with strictly positive values, an empty owner can be EFX only if every other owner bundle is a singleton; three nonempty owner bundles cannot hold all twelve goods
